basic_info.description: Price Reduced Again!  This 1937 well-maintained Corona Heights neighborhood apartment building consists of six spacious 1 bedroom / 1 bathroom units with identical floor plan is located at 230 Castro St.(cross sts @ 15th/Beaver) in a prime location of San Francisco. Five tenant occupied units/One vacant unit ideal for owner or rent at market rate. Large garage to accommodate 3 cars. Low expenses with decent incomes(Projected $186,756/Yr).
